title: Execute source-bound banded forward matrix actions on fixed tapes (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
Construct a physical fixed-tape forward action for a real band matrix F, including singular F, by embedding `N[2i,2j+1]=-F[i,j]` in a square-zero lift and using the unchanged rounded inverse-page service once. Actual page preparation, staged truncation, input restoration, zero padding and protected output are charged. The complete count is `2(2ceil(2n/b)-1)ceil(r/b)` matrix products, each with `7^log2(b)` scalar leaves. No new κ.

## Sources and verification
Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; retained kernel pin `f821cba68f44048e70e78afb75603ed4dde99f11`, Reference adapter pin `a99c4dce9f6bf1972b13f0f239e082ac70a9e5e8`, full hashes in SOURCES.json. Run `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-banded-forward-action`; expected `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All four normal/optimized physical/independent controls passed in the research session. Independent full-Q matrix, singular three-row and short reuse fixtures checked 98/294/6 scalar leaves; controls reject wrong signs, early rounding, aliases, padding and unconsumed returns.

## Limits and credit
A supplied already-packed RHS is assumed; full broad union routing, setup, tensor/CRT recovery and all five framework assumptions remain open. @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI verification. Credit #5059, #4205, #481 and inherited authors. Apache-2.0.
